text: 51-year-old woman. speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience shortness of breath or wheezing, and have you ever had a chest X-ray or CT scan to evaluate your lung structure? I would also like to know if you have any history of allergic rhinitis, asthma, or gastrointestinal reflux disease.

text: Do you have a history of recurrent sinopulmonary infections or nasal polyps, and do you experience food aversions or abdominal pain after eating fatty foods? I need to rule out Cystic Fibrosis or Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia given your non-smoking status.

text: Past medical history: No other significant past medical history aside from the recurrent bronchitis. Social history: Non-smoker, no history of alcohol or drug abuse.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the chronic nature of your symptoms and non-smoking status, I need to evaluate your lung structure and function. REQUEST TEST: High_Resolution_CT_Scan_of_Chest. REQUEST TEST: Pulmonary_Function_Tests.

speaker: Doctor

text: Given the normal CT scan and lack of GERD symptoms, I must consider less common causes of chronic suppurative cough. Do you have any history of sinusitis, nasal polyps, or dental issues, and have you ever noticed foul-tasting sputum?

text: Given the copious purulent sputum and normal CT scan, I suspect a central airway issue like bronchiectasis or a retained foreign body that might be subtle on standard imaging. REQUEST TEST: Bronchoscopy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since structural causes like bronchiectasis and foreign bodies have been ruled out by normal CT and bronchoscopy, I need to consider infectious etiologies.
